new_concerns_after_fix.issue: Whitespace-only TOML key (e.g., "   ") bypasses !k.is_empty() check, served as 200 OK and cached as valid key, causing silent fleet-wide auth failures for 300s until next fetch (crates/racecontrol/src/api/mesh_intelligence.rs:Some(k) if !k.is_empty() arm)

Server-side tracing::error! on empty key lacks alerting hook; operator emptying key produces no page/alert without external log aggregation (crates/racecontrol/src/api/mesh_intelligence.rs:tracing::error! line)

C-1 acceptance ignores material blast radius change: HKLM required local admin/pod compromise, network endpoint requires only LAN access (shared with customer WiFi), removing a security boundary layer

WMIC deprecation deferred but silent failure mode (exit 0 with 0 matches) allows deploy to report success while watchdog survives, risking 03:13-race recurrence on 24H2+ (deploy-server.sh:WMIC commandline kill)
C-4 300s unauthenticated window during peak reboots may cause telemetry blackouts; no customer-visible impact assessment provided (rc-agent/src/mesh_key_cache.rs:fetch_interval)

findings.one_liner: Whitespace key bypasses empty-check causing silent auth failures; IP-gated endpoint materially expands blast radius vs HKLM.

findings.one_liner: Key exposure via IP-authenticated endpoint poses unacceptable spoof risk; WMIC defer and auth-logging gaps also remain.

new_concerns_after_fix.issue: racecontrol/api/mesh_intelligence.rs pods_mesh_service_key returns 503 only; rc-agent fetch_from_server uses fetch interval 300s, but preserves cache on error. If server restarts with empty/unset TOML and cache is empty on first boot, pods may run without key (potential auth break) for up to first successful fetch window; no explicit 'bootstrap_required' guard observed from the described change.

racecontrol/api/mesh_intelligence.rs: condition uses as_deref() then k.is_empty(); whitespace-only ("   ") passes is_empty and will be served as a key (render_mesh_service_key_body(k)). This reintroduces a 'bad key' failure mode (not covered by provided tests). File: crates/racecontrol/src/api/mesh_intelligence.rs in handler pods_mesh_service_key.

rc-agent csv_lap_fallback: change appears log-level only (401/403 => distinct WARN). If deploy monitoring only alerts on ERROR/5xx patterns, auth failures can still be missed; described fix does not add metrics/alerting or escalation logic. File: crates/rc-agent/src/csv_lap_fallback.rs.

findings.one_liner: Fixes reduce silent outages but whitespace/boot-edge cases and log-only auth surfacing remain; challenge deploy until these are proven safe.
